title: Jubilant Herbal Canadian Lentil Stew
description: A hearty and comforting Canadian dish featuring a mixture of herbs and lentils in a creamy stew, perfect for a cold winter's night. This macrobiotic-friendly recipe is made with a soffritto base and a blend of aromatic herbs.
instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion, carrots, and celery until the vegetables are tender.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the mixture powder, dried thyme, and dried rosemary, and cook for 1 minute, until the spices are fragrant.
Add the rinsed lentils, vegetable broth, and coconut cream to the pot, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste, then serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Let the stew cool completely before refrigerating or freezing for later use.
Reheat the stew over low heat, whisking constantly, until warmed through.
